dslRule:
<!id: stubutility2.to.stubutility2core>
<!description: Migrate static method calls from StubUtility2 to StubUtility2Core.>_
<!severity: WARNING>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.codemanipulation.StubUtility2.$method($args$)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.codemanipulation.StubUtility2Core.$method($args$)
;;
summary: Replaces all static method calls on `StubUtility2` with corresponding calls on `StubUtility2Core`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
